note: Expected findings are the code, path, message and suggestion `orb validate` (the Rust validator) reports for the same program. The first eleven cases copy the unit tests in circuit/cross_orbital/filter_field_written.rs by name; the rest cover the identity, intrinsic, @config fold, persist batch and client-bound arms of the same function. Difference from the Rust fold: a comparand folds only as a scalar literal or an @config.<knob> default (anything else, an operator call or a record, is undecidable and silent, where Rust would evaluate it).

findings.suggestion: Supply `channelKey` in the `persist create`/`update ThreadPost` data that produces the rows this filter targets, or drop `channelKey` from the filter if it is dead.
